mapper.select: select ti.id as trackId, ti.track_title as trackTitle, ti.media_duration as mediaDuration, ti.order_num as orderNum, ti.create_time as createTime, ifnull(ts_play.stat_num, 0) as playStatNum, ifnull(ts_comment.stat_num, 0) as commentStatNum, ifnull(ts_comment.stat_num, 0) as albumCommentStatNum from track_info ti left join track_stat ts_play on ts_play.track_id = ti.id and ts_play.stat_type = '0701' and ts_play.is_deleted = 0 left join track_stat ts_comment on ts_comment.track_id = ti.id and ts_comment.stat_type = '0704' and ts_comment.is_deleted = 0 where ti.album_id = #{albumId} and ti.is_deleted = 0 order by ti.order_num asc, ti.id asc
